avertissementTitre: Working draft, to be reviewed by a lawyer
avertissement: This document is a first version written for the launch of SoliFund. It must be reviewed and approved by a lawyer under Cameroonian law before the site goes public. Passages in square brackets still need to be completed. If the English and French versions differ, the French version applies.

conditions.introduction: These terms set out the rules for using SoliFund, for fundraiser organisers and donors alike.

blocs: SoliFund is an online platform that lets any registered person (the “organiser”) start a fundraiser for a personal, family, community or charitable project, and lets anyone (the “donor”) contribute to it by Mobile Money (MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money), in CFA francs (XAF).

SoliFund provides the technical tool: fundraiser pages, collection of gifts through a payment provider, tracking of amounts, and payment of the funds to the organiser. SoliFund is not the organiser of the projects shown and does not guarantee that they will be carried out.
These terms apply to anyone who uses the site, with or without an account.
You need an account to start a fundraiser, give or comment. You agree to provide accurate information (last name, first name, email address, phone number) and to keep it up to date.

Your email address must be verified before you can start a fundraiser or request a withdrawal. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for any activity carried out from your account.
[Minimum age for opening an account to be specified.]
By starting a fundraiser, the organiser agrees to:

liste: describe the project honestly and fully, with no misleading information;
use the funds raised only for the stated project;
post updates for donors and answer legitimate questions about how the funds are used;
publish only photos and text they hold the rights to, and that are respectful of other people;
not use SoliFund for any illegal activity, fraud, money laundering, funding of violent activities, or fundraising on behalf of a person without their consent;
comply with the tax and legal obligations that apply to the money they receive.

blocs: A fundraiser that has already received gifts cannot be deleted: it is cancelled, and its history is kept.
The minimum gift is 100 XAF. Payment is made by Mobile Money through the chosen operator; a gift is only counted once the payment provider has confirmed the payment.
A gift is voluntary and made with nothing expected in return. Except in the case of a technical error or proven fraud, it is not refundable. [Refund policy to be specified.]

Donors can choose to appear as anonymous: their name is then shown neither on the fundraiser page nor to the organiser. SoliFund nevertheless keeps the information to meet its record-keeping obligations.
A fundraiser no longer receives gifts after its end date, or while it is suspended or cancelled.

The organiser requests the withdrawal of all or part of the available funds to a Mobile Money number (100 XAF minimum). The available amount is the confirmed gifts, less any withdrawals already requested or paid.

Each request is checked by the SoliFund team before it is paid. It may be declined, with a reason, in particular if there is any doubt about the identity of the recipient or the use of the funds. No withdrawal is possible from a suspended or cancelled fundraiser. [Usual processing time to be specified.]

A gift is made up of two amounts: the gift itself, which is added in full to the fundraiser, and a transaction fee paid by the donor. This fee covers the costs charged by Mobile Money operators to collect the payment and then pay it out to the organiser. It is added on top of the gift: the organiser receives the full amount given.

The fee is a percentage of the gift: the collection rate of the donor's operator (MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money), plus the payout rate of the operator on which the organiser receives their funds. It is rounded up to the next CFA franc. The gift, the fee and the total to pay are shown before each payment; the amount requested on the phone is that total. The minimum gift amount applies to the gift, excluding the fee.

SoliFund charges a fee of <taux/> on each withdrawal requested by the organiser. It is calculated on the amount requested and rounded to the nearest CFA franc. It is deducted from the amount paid out: for a withdrawal of 10,000 XAF at 3%, the fee is 300 XAF and the organiser receives 9,700 XAF. The fee and the amount to be received are shown before each request.

The rates applied are those in force when the gift is made or the withdrawal is requested; a change of rate does not affect gifts already made or withdrawals already requested. [Pricing policy to be approved by a lawyer.]
Any other charges made by Mobile Money operators to their customers remain subject to those operators' own terms.

SoliFund may suspend a fundraiser (no more gifts or withdrawals, page hidden from the public) if it is reported, if its content breaches these terms, or if fraud is suspected. The organiser is told the reason.
An account may be temporarily suspended or banned for a serious breach. Banning an account suspends its active fundraisers.

The organiser is solely responsible for the content of their fundraiser and for how the funds are used. SoliFund takes reasonable steps to keep the service running properly, without guaranteeing that it will always be available.
SoliFund cannot be held liable for an interruption or error caused by a Mobile Money operator, the payment provider or the network. [Limits of liability to be approved by a lawyer.]
How we handle your data is described in the <lien>privacy policy</lien>.

confidentialite.introduction: This page explains what data SoliFund collects, why, who it is shared with, and how to exercise your rights.

blocs: Personal data collected on SoliFund is processed by [publisher's company name and address to be added], in line with the Cameroonian regulations that apply to the protection of personal data. [Legal references and any formalities with the competent authority to be specified by a lawyer.]
We only collect the data needed to provide the service:

liste: account: last name, first name, email address, phone number (optional), password (stored in protected form, never in plain text);
fundraisers: title, description, dates, goal, cover photo, updates posted;
gifts: amount, operator, Mobile Money number used to pay, optional message, choice to stay anonymous;
withdrawals: amount, operator and Mobile Money number of the recipient;
comments posted on fundraisers;
technical data: sign-up date, history of operations and server logs.

blocs: Photos you upload are converted by our servers, and their metadata (such as the GPS position recorded by the device) is removed.
Your data is used to:

liste: create and secure your account, verify your email address, reset your password;
display fundraisers, gifts (without a name for anonymous gifts) and comments;
process payments and withdrawals, and let you know about them by notification;
prevent fraud, moderate content and meet our legal obligations.

blocs: Your data is neither sold nor used for advertising.

liste: on a public fundraiser: its content, and the organiser's first name and last-name initial;
the list of gifts: the donor's first and last name, unless they chose to stay anonymous;
comments, with their author's name.

blocs: Data is accessible to the SoliFund team within the limits of its duties, and is passed on to:

liste: our payment provider and the Mobile Money operators (MTN, Orange), for payments;
Brevo, to send emails (verification and reset codes);
our hosting provider [name and hosting country to be added].

blocs: [Any transfers outside Cameroon and the related safeguards to be specified.]

Account data is kept for as long as the account is active. The history of gifts, payments and withdrawals is kept for the period required by accounting and legal obligations. [Exact periods to be set.]

SoliFund uses no advertising cookies and no audience measurement tool. When you log in, your login token (valid for 24 hours) and your profile information are saved in your browser's local storage; they are erased when you log out. Your language choice is also remembered there.

Passwords and verification codes are stored in protected form, exchanges with the site are secured, and access to administration features is restricted. Changing your password logs you out of your other devices.

You can access your data, correct it (from the “My profile” page for your last name, first name and phone number), ask for it to be deleted, or object to certain processing, within the limits set by law.
To exercise these rights, write to us at the address given below. [Response time to be specified.]
For any question about your data: [contact email address to be added]. See also the <lien>terms of use</lien>.
